title: Pool Pavilion
alt: Teak outdoor daybeds, ivory umbrella, and turquoise pool framed by banana trees and palm fronds.
notice: Notice how silvered teak calms the bright turquoise pool water without competing with lush greenery.
try_it: Ground high-chroma water or garden views with weathered grey timber seating.

title: Timber Atrium
alt: Indoor-outdoor lounge with curved oat linen sectional, vertical timber slat walls, skylight, and low oak tables.
notice: Notice how vertical timber slats turn daylight into architectural pattern across plain upholstery.
try_it: Run narrow vertical wood slats behind a curved sofa to break up flat drywall.

title: The Blush Door
alt: Blush pink townhouse entrance with dark green front door, brass lion knocker, and terracotta potted plants.
notice: Notice how one deep green door makes the whole blush facade feel intentional.
try_it: Ground a soft wall color with one dark, glossy door.

title: Stucco & Shadow
alt: Cream stucco Mediterranean villa with stone balustrade balconies and sharp diagonal palm tree shadows.
notice: Notice how stark sun shadows do the ornamental work that moldings usually have to do.
try_it: Keep exterior walls flat and pale where trees can paint daily moving shadows.

title: Boulevard Golden Hour
alt: Classic European stone apartment buildings with wrought-iron balconies and rooftop gardens against a clear blue sky.
notice: Notice how lush rooftop plantings soften heavy classical stone corners against the sky.
try_it: Crown a structured parapet or balcony ledge with dense evergreen container plantings.

title: Solitary Palm
alt: Single California fan palm centered against a pale warm sky with fine film grain.
notice: Notice how a single tall silhouette can hold an entire field of negative space.
try_it: Anchor a tall empty corner with one sculptural potted palm instead of gallery art.

title: Coastal Horizon
alt: Ocean horizon viewed through a stand of slender palm trunks with soft coastal shrubs in the foreground.
notice: Notice how layering foreground foliage turns a generic horizon into a private framed vista.
try_it: Layer sheer linen drapes and tall floor plants to frame wide window views.
